evals.name: single-unit-oci-target
evals.prompt: Bind my 'checkout' unit in space myapp-dev to an OCI target so ArgoCD can deploy it.
evals.expected_output: Reads existing worker/Target/Space/Unit state, then prepares (but does not execute) proposals for a server worker if needed, an OCI target, `cub space update myapp-dev --release-target <target-space>/<target>`, and checkout's matching Unit TargetID. Discloses every other Unit already in the resulting EffectiveReleaseSet, requires new approval if scope expands, and BLOCKs on the missing external broker. Notes ArgoCD configuration is a separate integration.

evals.name: bulk-bind-by-label
evals.prompt: All units labeled Tier=backend in myapp-staging should publish through the oci-target we already have in the shared targets space. Set that up for all of them.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the label selector to exact UnitIDs and verifies targets/oci-target is OCI. Confirms or proposes myapp-staging ReleaseTargetID and prepares the exact unit set-target command, but does not run either. Shows the before/after EffectiveReleaseSet (which may include non-backend Units already on that Target), requires re-approval for changed scope, and BLOCKs pending the external broker.

evals.name: do-i-need-a-worker
evals.prompt: Do I need to run a worker process before I can create a target and apply my units?
evals.expected_output: Explains that current OCI Release delivery uses a server-worker entity hosted by ConfigHub, so no external process is needed. Shows the server-worker and OCI Target forms as proposal-only, includes the load-bearing Space.ReleaseTargetID and Unit.TargetID steps, and distinguishes external workers for custom functions. Labels direct ConfigHub-provider Release delivery VERSIONED_LEGACY/BLOCK.
